Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TameThreshold_tool: How much trust a pet must reach (by feeding) before it becomes your companion.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaxCompanions_tool: Maximum number of animals a player can keep bonded at once. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CombatEnabled_tool: Allow pets to attack nearby zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogDamageMultiplie: Default damage is 1. 0 means the pet can no longer kill zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_UpkeepEnabled_tool: Turns hunger, thirst, loyalty and stress on or off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_NeedsRateMultiplie: Daily hunger and thirst rate. Raise it and the pet eats and drinks more often.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_LoyaltyDecayPerDay: Base loss. A hungry or thirsty pet loses it faster.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinNeedEnabled: Enables the animal's need for protein in its diet.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ProteinHours_toolt: How many hours a pet can go without protein before it turns Weak.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SentinelEnabled_to: The pets' ability to detect zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BondingEnabled_too: Less boredom when petting or sleeping next to the animal.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffEnabled_: Moodle whose buff reduces panic, stress, sadness and boredom and makes you tire more slowly.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_RestedBuffHours_to: How many hours the Well Rested moodle lasts.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedMoodlesEnable: Enables the moodle with each breed's unique buffs.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_SkillXPRate_toolti: Global multiplier for the pet's skills.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_FarmCareEnabled_to: Lets the pet take on caring for animals in pens. Affects server performance (low impact).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TricksEnabled_tool: Enables the pet's tricks. Can be OP on a server.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogNoiseAttractsZo: Barking, meowing and the like can attract zombies.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_ShowNameTags_toolt: Text with the pet's name. Turn off for more immersion.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DogSpawnMultiplier: Animal spawn rate. Default is 1, 0 disables spawning.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_WildDogsInvincible: When on, wild animals cannot die from vehicles, fire, attacks and the like.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_DespawnOnOwnerOffl: Stash pets while owner is offline
When the owner logs out of the server, the animal leaves with them.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_CargoCapacityMulti: Multiplies the saddlebag's cargo capacity. 0 makes it purely cosmetic.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedingEnabled_to: Lets pets breed. Affects server performance (low impact).
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_GestationDays_tool: How many in-game days a pregnant pet carries before giving birth.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_MaturityDays_toolt: How many in-game days a puppy takes to grow into an adult.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_BreedChancePerDay_: Percent chance per in-game day that a nearby adult male and female with the same owner breed on their own (rolled hourly). Same conditions as manual breeding: fed, loyal, healthy, off cooldown, a free dog slot, and breeding not blocked on either. Only while they are loaded near you. 0 = off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_TripOverDogs_toolt: When on, running into a pet can knock you down.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetCareEnabled_too: The pet can pick up wounds and illnesses. Default: on.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetRecipesUnlocked: Everyone starts out knowing every vet care recipe, no need for the mod's magazine.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWoundChance_too: Chance that a bite the pet lands on a zombie hurts its paw. Default 0.4 percent. Each Combat level of the pet lowers it by 5 percent of this value, so at level 10 it is halved.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSprainChance_to: Percent chance that each fence the pet hops leaves it with a sprained paw. Default 0.5, 0 means never.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance: Worms chance per 6 h with an upset stomach (percent)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetWormsChance_too: Percent chance the pet catches worms for every 6 hours with an upset stomach. Default 10 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetSpoiledChance_t: Chance that bad food or water leaves the pet vomiting. Default 25 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_Death_tooltip: The pet can die of illness, hunger and thirst. Default: off.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetFluChance_toolt: Chance of catching the flu: rolled while the pet is starving, and for each hour beside a sick dog. Default 15 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetHeartwormChance: Rolled for every 6 straight hours outdoors. Going indoors resets the count. Default 1.5 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetAllergyChance_t: Chance that the pet is born allergic to one meat for life, rolled once per pet. Default 5 percent.
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance: Flea and tick chance per bite (percent)
Sandbox_CompanionDogs_VetInfestChance_to: Chance that each bite in a fight brings fleas or ticks. Default 0.2 percent.
